reviews.shade: [Sanrio EDITION] Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Soothing Mist 125ml Set (+POCHACCO Shoes Charm 2ea)
reviews.text: Feels nice after spraying! It’s getting warm so I brought the whole bottle to work, and give myself face a spray when I finish work, feeling refreshed while going home ☺️
reviews.zh: 噴完感覺好舒服！天氣越嚟越熱，所以我將成支噴霧帶去返工，收工嗰陣就替自己個面噴一下，一路返屋企都覺得精神好咗 ☺️

reviews.shade: [Sanrio EDITION] Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Soothing Mist 125ml Set (+POCHACCO Shoes Charm 2ea)
reviews.text: I have a cream mist from this brand. But this time I try soothing mist which is lighter. I spray it after cleansing then moisturiser.
reviews.zh: 我之前用過呢個品牌嘅霜狀噴霧。不過呢次我試咗較輕盈嘅舒緩噴霧。我係潔面之後、保濕霜之前噴。

reviews.shade: [Sanrio EDITION] Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Soothing Mist 125ml Set (+POCHACCO Shoes Charm 2ea)
reviews.text: I love keeping this around when my skin feels dry during the day. It’s refreshing and gives a quick boost of hydration without making my face feel sticky.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意日間皮膚感覺乾嗰陣，隨身帶住呢款噴霧。佢清爽，可以即時補充水分，而且唔會令面覺得黏。

reviews.shade: [Sanrio EDITION] Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Soothing Mist 125ml Set (+POCHACCO Shoes Charm 2ea)
reviews.text: Love the mist! It's very hydrating and leaves your skin very plump! Love the Pochacco collection!!
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款噴霧！保濕效果好好，令皮膚飽滿好多！好鍾意 Pochacco 系列！！

reviews.shade: [Sanrio EDITION] Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Soothing Mist 125ml Set (+POCHACCO Shoes Charm 2ea)
reviews.text: Very refreshing and gentle on the skin. Provides hydration and leaves my skin feeling soft, clean, and balanced.
reviews.zh: 非常清爽，對皮膚好溫和。可以補水，令皮膚感覺柔軟、乾淨、平衡。

reviews.shade: [Sanrio EDITION] Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Soothing Mist 125ml Set (+POCHACCO Shoes Charm 2ea)
reviews.text:
パケがかわいいので一生使いたい。詰め替え用があればいいのに。
勢いよく噴射されるので、メイクの上から使うのには向いて無いと思います。
クーリング効果なのか、付けたては少し刺激があります。
reviews.zh:
包裝好可愛，想一世都用。如果有補充裝就好啦。
噴出嚟好大力，所以我覺得唔太啱喺化妝上面用。
可能係冷卻效果，剛剛搽嗰陣有少少刺激。

reviews.shade: [Sanrio EDITION] Torriden Dive In Low Molecular Hyaluronic Acid Soothing Mist 125ml Set (+POCHACCO Shoes Charm 2ea)
reviews.text:
サンリオコラボしてるの見てあまりにも可愛くて
購入してしまいました
まだ日本に販売されてないタイプのスプレーでしたが
しっとり保湿もしてくれるのでメイク前やお風呂上がりにも
使える幅が広くて嬉しいです✨️
reviews.zh:
見到佢同 Sanrio 聯乘，實在太可愛，忍唔住買咗。
雖然係日本未有發售嘅款式嘅噴霧，
但係都會滋潤保濕，所以無論係化妝前定係沐浴後都可以用，用途好闊，好開心✨️
